from fastmcp.server import create_proxy

# `backend_mcp` is the existing in-memory FastMCP server instance.
# create_proxy() wraps it in an in-memory Client and forwards every
# tool/resource/prompt request to it transparently.
proxy_mcp = create_proxy(backend_mcp, name="Proxy Server")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    proxy_mcp.run()
